answer: Agents bond stake and commit a Semaphore identity to an epoch polynomial; each message carries a zero-knowledge proof and rate-limit nullifier. Within an epoch, valid messages produce Shamir shares tied to that nullifier: duplicate use exposes enough shares to reconstruct the identity secret, proving equivocation rather than merely flagging it. The verifier then slashes the bonded collateral immediately. The ridge, jetty, and knoll labels can denote separate epoch domains, preventing cross-domain collisions.
